label: Paiste Innovations China 18″
description: Paiste Innovations China 18″; independently recorded real instrument, no manufacturer endorsement. Alexander Holm original overhead recording. Exact series/type/size as stated in author README.
attribution: Recorded by Alexander Holm. Original historical CC BY-SA 3.0 README retained; author dedicated all his sampled instruments to public domain in March 2022. Converted original audio to PCM16 stereo 44.1 kHz with uniform -3 dB headroom before resampling; natural tails and source onset retained, no per-hit normalization, no source SFZ gain baked in.
layerNotes: Source SFZ velocity groups retained; first up to four real recorded alternatives per group. Same-layer alternatives are genuine separate performances. No synthesized variants; no tail truncation.

quality.tail: Original recorded tail preserved; no fade or tail truncation added.
